description: This file is a Python script for generating OpenGL API code, including trampoline functions, API prototypes, and enum entries, based on XML registry data. It defines classes for code generation and processes OpenGL extension and API specifications.

classes.name: TrampolineGen
classes.description: Generates API trampoline functions that wrap OpenGL calls, handling different return types and function names.

classes.name: ApiGenerator
classes.description: Collects and outputs OpenGL API command prototypes and enums, removing duplicates and filtering certain entries.

classes.name: SpecGenerator
classes.description: Creates specification entries for OpenGL API functions for use by legacy code.

methods.name: genCmd
methods.description: Generates code for a specific API command, including function entry and call dispatch.

methods.name: genEnum
methods.description: Processes and filters enum definitions, avoiding bitmask and non-hex values.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes the list of commands by sorting and removing duplicates.

methods.name: writeEntries
methods.description: Outputs the collected API commands to a file.

methods.name: writeEnums
methods.description: Outputs the collected enums to a file.

methods.name: genCmd
methods.description: Outputs a function prototype and parameters for a command.
